Comprehensive Solutions for Website Technical Errors

Ready to fix your website’s technical errors and take it to the next level? Contact WevTEC for a comprehensive assessment and tailored solutions that meet your unique needs.

WevTEC ensures your site projects a trustworthy image, inspiring customer confidence. We are pleased to partner with local agencies in the US to provide technical support.

We offer same-day repairs for minor website issues within 2–4 hours. Depending on the diagnosis, costs range from $50 to $150. Call now to get a free spot diagnosis, turnaround time, and quote once you are on the phone with our website fixer.

Call Fixer Now

MIGRATION & LAYOUT

Migration, broken layout, fixing common errors, slow performance

Website Emergency?

We Can Get Your Website Functioning Flawlessly

Having a website is crucial for any business in today’s digital age. But a website riddled with technical errors can drive visitors away faster than you can say “conversion rate.” At WevTEC Website Fixing Services, we specialize in identifying and resolving technical issues that are sabotaging your online presence.

  • Our team of experts will meticulously scan your website for broken links, malfunctioning plugins, slow loading times, and other technical glitches that hinder user experience and search engine visibility.
  • We don’t just fix errors; we optimize your website for search engines. We’ll ensure your website adheres to the latest SEO guidelines, making it easier for potential customers to find you online.
  • A website riddled with technical problems is frustrating for visitors. WevTEC streamlines your website, creating a smooth and enjoyable user experience that keeps visitors engaged and coming back for more.
Consultation With Fixer: It's FREE
Website Functionality?

Our 14-Point Website Technical Audit

At WevTEC, we understand that a flawless website is crucial for your online success. Our comprehensive website fixing services ensure your site performs optimally, remains secure, and provides an excellent user experience. Here’s a detailed look at how we tackle various technical issues on your website.

1. Links

Broken or incorrect links can frustrate users and negatively impact your site’s SEO. We thoroughly audit your website to identify and fix broken links, ensuring all internal and external links function correctly.

Services Include:

  • Identifying broken and outdated links
  • Correcting or removing broken links
  • Updating internal link structure for better navigation

2. Indexability

A website that is not properly indexed by search engines will not appear in search results, affecting visibility and traffic. We ensure that your site is fully indexable by search engines.

Services Include:

  • Checking robots.txt file and meta tags
  • Ensuring all pages are crawlable
  • Submitting sitemap to search engines

3. Content Relevance

Relevant and high-quality content is key to engaging your audience and improving SEO. We evaluate your content to ensure it is relevant, well-structured, and optimized for your target keywords.

Services Include:

  • Content audit and optimization
  • Keyword research and integration
  • Enhancing content readability and engagement

4. Duplicate Content

Duplicate content can lead to SEO penalties and confuse search engines. We identify and resolve issues with duplicate content to enhance your site’s SEO performance.

Services Include:

  • Scanning for duplicate content
  • Implementing canonical tags
  • Merging or rewriting duplicate pages

5. Security

Website security is paramount to protect your data and your users. We implement robust security measures to safeguard your site against threats.

Services Include:

  • Installing and configuring SSL certificates
  • Conducting security audits and vulnerability assessments
  • Implementing firewalls and security plugins

6. Internal Linking

A well-structured internal linking strategy improves user navigation and SEO. We optimize your internal links to enhance site architecture and user experience.

Services Include:

  • Mapping internal link structure
  • Adding strategic internal links
  • Ensuring all links are relevant and beneficial

7. Page Speed

Slow-loading pages can deter visitors and harm your SEO. We optimize your website’s speed to ensure a fast and smooth user experience.

Services Include:

  • Analyzing page load times
  • Compressing images and files
  • Implementing caching solutions

8. Redirects

Proper redirects are essential to maintain SEO equity and avoid broken links. We manage and optimize your redirects to ensure seamless navigation.

Services Include:

  • Setting up 301 and 302 redirects
  • Removing unnecessary redirects
  • Ensuring proper redirect chains

9. Social Media

A strong social media presence enhances your online visibility and engagement. We integrate your social media platforms with your website for better reach and interaction.

Services Include:

  • Adding social media buttons and feeds
  • Optimizing content for social sharing
  • Ensuring consistent branding across platforms

10. Code Validation

Valid code ensures your website functions correctly and is accessible to all users. We validate and clean up your website’s code for optimal performance.

Services Include:

  • Checking HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for errors
  • Correcting code validation issues
  • Ensuring compliance with web standards

11. Search Traffic

Improving your website’s search traffic is essential for growth. We analyze and implement strategies to boost your organic search traffic.

Services Include:

  • Conducting SEO audits
  • Implementing on-page and off-page SEO techniques
  • Monitoring and adjusting strategies based on performance

12. Mobile Friendly

A mobile-friendly website is crucial in today’s digital landscape. We ensure your site is fully responsive and provides a great user experience on all devices.

Services Include:

  • Implementing responsive design
  • Testing on various mobile devices
  • Optimizing mobile loading speed

13. XML Sitemaps

XML sitemaps help search engines understand your site’s structure. We create and submit accurate sitemaps to improve your site’s indexability.

Services Include:

  • Generating XML sitemaps
  • Submitting sitemaps to search engines
  • Regularly updating sitemaps

14. Localization

Localized content helps you reach a broader audience. We optimize your website for local search to attract local customers.

Services Include:

  • Implementing local SEO strategies
  • Creating location-specific content
  • Managing Google My Business listings
Free Consultation
Get Fixed ASAP

Benefits of a Flawless Website

Fixing technical errors boosts your search engine ranking, making it easier for potential customers to find your business. A flawlessly functioning website keeps visitors engaged, leading to more conversions and sales.

Higher Search Rankings

Technical errors can significantly impact your search engine ranking. By fixing these issues, you’ll climb the search engine ladder, making it easier for potential customers to find your business.

A Brand People Trust

A professional and well-functioning website reflects positively on your brand. WevTEC helps you project a trustworthy and reliable image that inspires customer confidence.

More Conversions and Sales

A website that functions flawlessly keeps visitors happy and engaged. This translates to more conversions, leads, and ultimately, more sales for your business.

Complex Issues

We Fix It All

No matter your website’s complexity – dynamic sites, e-commerce platforms, SPAs, blogs, membership systems, or anything in between – our expert team tackles every technical hurdle. We’re fluent in the languages that power the web (PHP, Python, Ruby, etc.) and major platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Magento). Let WevTEC ensure your website runs flawlessly.

Free SEO Report

Extended Support for Agencies

In addition to fixing technical errors, WevTEC can also help you with:

  • Website User Experience Optimization
  • Google Analytics Setup and Guidance
  • Bounce Rate Reduction Strategies
  • Content Marketing Consulting
  • Backlink Building Techniques
  • Website Accessibility Compliance
  • Voice Search Optimization
  • Schema Markup Implementation
  • Conversion Tracking Solutions
